note: A backend+frontend repository: the only ESLint config is frontend/eslint.config.mjs, beside frontend/package.json, and only it enables no-console, so a manual result proves it applied. The spec's package.json workspace indicator runs ESLint from frontend/. ESLint 9 finds its flat config from the working directory, so run from the project root it failed operationally ("couldn't find an eslint.config"); ESLint 10 looks from each file's directory and passes either way, so this case guards the fix only under ESLint 9 (checked with 9.39.2 and 10.11.0).
